This [[Starship/Legends|starship]], used by a [[Lurmen village/Legends|group]] of [[Lurmen/Legends|Lurmen]] [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]], was referred to as an "'''ol' boat'''."

==History==
The antiquated [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] was built prior to [[52 BBY/Legends|52 BBY]].<ref name="The Clone Wars: Neighbors">In ''[[The Clone Wars: Neighbors]]'' [[Tee Watt Kaa/Legends|Tee Watt Kaa]] described the vessel as over 30 years old, placing its building some time before [[52 BBY/Legends|52 BBY]].</ref> It transported a [[Lurmen village/Legends|group]] of [[Lurmen/Legends|Lurmen]] [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]] from their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]<ref name=":0">''[[The Clone Wars: Neighbors]]''</ref> [[Mygeeto/Legends|Mygeeto]]<ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''</ref> to [[Maridun/Legends|Maridun]]. The Lurmen, led by [[Tee Watt Kaa/Legends|Tee Watt Kaa]], were forced to settle on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] after the ship was disabled by [[Amani/Legends|Amani]] warriors. The Amani both prized and hated the [[Alien/Legends|alien]] object, and instead of fighting for it, the Lurmen departed in an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]], leaving the ship behind for the taking.<ref name=":0" />
